import { ProductRepository } from '../../domain/product/ProductRepository';
import { ProductStockDto, toProductStockDto } from '../dto/ProductStockDto';

export class ListProductStockUseCase {
  constructor(private readonly products: ProductRepository) {}

  execute(): ProductStockDto[] {
    return this.products.findAll().map(toProductStockDto);
  }
}
